Better model recommendations.

- **The 12B is offered on more machines:** from 8 GB of VRAM with 16 GB of RAM (it was measured on 8 GB of VRAM with 32 GB of RAM), and from 10 GB of VRAM with only 8 GB of RAM. Before, many machines got the same model for both tiers.
- **The context size follows the machine:** 64k tokens for big cards (fast model from 12 GB of VRAM, quality model from 24 GB, or 14 GB for the 12B), 32k otherwise. Applied on first setup, by `readscout pull` and by "Use these models" in the setup page; existing configs are not changed until you use that button, or edit `models.<tier>.ctx` in `config.json`. The 64k contexts are not benchmarked yet.

Update: run the installer again, or `uv tool install --force https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.5/readscout-0.1.5-py3-none-any.whl`.
Plugin users: `/plugin marketplace update readscout`, then restart Claude Code.
